steps: Begin show A, pause actual adapter loader after it captured originalChildren.
Begin show B on the same host; resolve B loader first; await B show: current session ready, one current canvas.
Resolve A loader; actual adapter creates old canvas; controller detects stale generation and calls old session.dispose.
Actual dispose removes every child absent from its originalChildren set, including B canvas.
source_findings: 3dmolAdapter.ts mount captures originalChildren before await load.
Its dispose removes all current nonoriginal children, rather than only children owned by that session.
Controller stale-generation check after mount cannot make this broad disposal safe.

repair_acceptance_plan.task: Add deterministic regression tests for all three schedules using real controller and adapter modules. Preserve zero-canvas failure, stale loading and stale-ready assertions as original witnesses.

Make each mount/dispose/failure cleanup own its DOM nodes/container and sizing. Old disposal must not remove or resize a newer session. Check current generation after every awaited lifecycle boundary, including prior disposal and resize. An isolated per-generation container is one possible design; review ownership through resize, labels, select, failed mount and final dispose.

Add positive sequential mount/replacement, current failure, stale failed load and dispose-while-loading controls. Confirm only the selected current generation can publish loading/ready/error or mutate current DOM.

Run applicable unit and real-browser smoke acceptance on the reviewed repair source; require actual selected candidate/fixture, semantic rows and canvas existence together. Keep existing assertions and first logs. Do not mask with WebGL flags, retries or fixed sleep.
